Yuki Tsunoda's teammates from 2021 onward were Pierre Gasly (AlphaTauri, 2021–22), Daniel Ricciardo (AlphaTauri, 2023), Liam Lawson (RB, 2024), and Max Verstappen (Red Bull, 2025). The search results confirm Tsunoda and Verstappen as Red Bull teammates in 2025, and they show Tsunoda at AlphaTauri in 2021 and RB in 2024, but they don't list every teammate pairing directly. The rest of the lineup comes from my own knowledge of the team rosters, not from the retrieved reports.

Of these, only Max Verstappen won a drivers' championship in 2000–2025, taking the titles in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024. Gasly, Ricciardo and Lawson have not won one.

ANSWER: Max Verstappen
